To read your current wallpaper for previews and blur, %1$s needs Android’s “All files access” permission. Open Settings and enable “Allow access to manage all files”. You can revoke this access at any time.

Allow %1$s to find files throughout shared storage. All files access also lets wallpaper previews and Blur wallpaper read your current wallpaper. You can keep using a selected folder for file search without granting this access.
